author: laura.desmet@lumivia.be
title: Remote work equipment & peripherals
body:
Everyone working from home can buy desk peripherals and expense them.

- Budget: up to €500 per employee per year.
- Covers: monitors, keyboards, mice, headsets, webcams, docking stations.
- Buy from any shop (Amazon, Coolblue, MediaMarkt...) and submit the receipt in Expensify.
- Under €500: no approval needed.
- Above €500: ask your line manager to approve in Expensify.

Laptops are not covered: those are always provided by IT.
